label: Passages per folder
sql: SELECT folder, count(*) AS n FROM {passages} GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

label: Count passages with a keyword
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM {passages} WHERE text ILIKE '%seamount%'

label: Rows for one decide call
sql: SELECT passage_id, title, page, text FROM {passages} WHERE folder = '8.2.4.Corals, 8.2.5.Sponges' AND text ILIKE '%coral%' LIMIT 401

label: Regex match, 50 rows
sql: SELECT passage_id, title, left(text, 500) AS text FROM {passages} WHERE regexp_matches(text, '(?i)hydrothermal vent|cold-water coral') ORDER BY passage_id LIMIT 51

label: Codebook summary from coded
sql: SELECT site, count(*) FILTER (crit_a > 0.7) AS a, count(*) FILTER (crit_m > 0.7) AS m, avg(content) AS content FROM {coded} WHERE content > 0.5 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

label: All passages of one paper
sql: SELECT passage_id, page, text FROM {passages} WHERE doc_id = 42 ORDER BY passage_id

label: One passage by id
sql: SELECT title, page, text FROM {passages} WHERE passage_id = 7000
